doc: League items Fiddlesticks builds, offered three at a time when a boss dies (max 6 owned). id = League item id: name, description, stats and icon come from the player's League client (items.json, es). Their ability power and ability haste apply; HP/armor/mana do not (Elden Ring keeps its own). effect = a simple version of the item's passive: burn (share of max HP per second for 3 s on ability hits), slow (on ability hits, 1 s), ap_mult, dmg_mult (ability damage), low_hp_mult (ability damage on targets under 40% HP), r_haste (Crowstorm ability haste), none.

rows.note: Tormento de Liandry: abilities burn for 3 s, value = share of the target's max HP per second
Antorcha de fuego negro: abilities burn for 3 s, value = share of max HP per second
Malignidad: value = extra ability haste for Crowstorm
Sombrero mortal de Rabadon: value = extra share of total ability power
Baston del Vacio (magic penetration): value = extra ability damage
Llamasombra: value = extra ability damage on targets under 40% HP
Cetro de cristal de Rylai: abilities slow by value for 1 s
Reloj de arena de Zhonya: T = estasis while League's Zhonya sound plays (value s if the sound is missing)
Morellonomicon: value = extra ability damage on targets under 40% HP
